fields.Field Explanation: Calendar year of the period being declared. The form is prescribed for periods from 1 August 2024 onward (Res. DIAN 000031 de 2024 art. 3).
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Explanation: Calendar month being declared, 01 to 12. Form 350 is a MONTHLY return; there is no quarterly or annual variant for withholding agents.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Explanation: Assigned by the DIAN electronic filing service, not by the declarant - the form prints 'Espacio reservado para la DIAN' against it. It becomes the reference quoted in casilla 26 of any later corrective return.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Explanation: Tax identification number of the withholding agent, taken from casilla 5 of the RUT. The last digit of this number determines the filing deadline (7th to 16th business day of the following month). Join key to the electronic payroll (NIE033) and to PILA.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Explanation: DIAN check digit of the NIT, from casilla 6 of the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the withholding agent is a NATURAL person. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11): a legal person populates 11 and leaves 7 to 10 blank, and a natural person does the reverse.
fields.Field Explanation: First surname of a natural-person withholding agent, from casilla 31 of the RUT. Auto-filled by the DIAN service from the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for a natural-person withholding agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
fields.Field Explanation: Second surname of a natural-person withholding agent, from casilla 32 of the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for a natural-person withholding agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
fields.Field Explanation: First given name of a natural-person withholding agent, from casilla 33 of the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for a natural-person withholding agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
fields.Field Explanation: Remaining given names of a natural-person withholding agent, from casilla 34 of the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the withholding agent is a LEGAL person. Mutually exclusive with the natural-person name casillas 7, 8, 9 and 10.
fields.Field Explanation: Corporate name, auto-filled by the DIAN service from casilla 35 of the RUT. The instruction guide says expressly that it 'se diligencia automaticamente' - do not attempt to override it.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Explanation: Code of the DIAN sectional office of the taxpayer's principal domicile, from casilla 12 of the RUT. A configuration attribute of the entity, not a period value.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated ONLY where this return corrects an earlier one. Bidirectional pair with 'Previous form number' (casilla 26): where 25 is populated 26 must be populated, and vice versa. Both blank on an initial return.
fields.Field Explanation: Set by the DIAN service: 1 = correction of the taxpayer's own return; 2 = correction of a DIAN-generated correction under Ley 962 de 2005 art. 43; 3 = correction prompted by an administrative act.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated ONLY on a corrective return. Bidirectional pair with 'Correction code' (casilla 25). Carries the casilla-4 number of the return being corrected.
fields.Field Explanation: The casilla 4 form number of the return, or of the administrative act, being corrected. This is the link that lets DIAN supersede the earlier filing rather than treat this one as a duplicate.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (EN): Self-withholding activity code (art. 114-1 exonerated legal persons)
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Autorretenedores Personas Juridicas exonerados de aportes (Art. 114-1 E.T.) - Actividad economica principal
fields.Conditional Reason: Fillable EXCLUSIVELY by legal persons that are exonerated from employer contributions under ET art. 114-1. Bidirectional pair with 'Self-withholding rate' (casilla 28), which the DIAN service derives automatically once 27 is chosen.
fields.Field Explanation: Principal economic-activity code from casilla 46 of the RUT, chosen from the codes in DIAN Resoluciones 000114 of 21 December 2020, 001232 of 16 September 2022 and 000086 of 24 May 2023. THE SAME ART. 114-1 EXONERATION that drives this casilla also drives PILA file tipo 1 field 33 and Record Tipo 2 field 76 - the employer that is exonerated from employer health, SENA and ICBF for employees under 10 SMMLV is the employer that self-withholds here.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Derived automatically by the DIAN service from 'Self-withholding activity code' (casilla 27); cannot be keyed independently. Bidirectional pair with casilla 27.
fields.Field Explanation: The self-withholding rate for the chosen activity, applied to ALL payments received. Set by DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.6.8. Not a payroll figure - it applies to the employer's own income, not to its employees.
fields.Rounding: Rate as printed by the DIAN service.

fields.Field Name (EN): =payroll withholding - the two casillas that payroll owns(sheet 1, 77 and 93) ===========

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Rentas de trabajo - base sujeta a retencion
fields.Field Explanation: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE BASE SIDE. The instruction guide defines it as 'los payments gravables (base sujeta a withholding) efectuados a natural persons por concept de salaries, commissions, prestaciones sociales, travel allowances, representation expenses, fees, emolumentos eclesiasticos, compensation received por el trabajo cooperative associate, payments en especie, payments en acciones y, en general, las compensation for personal services'. NOTE that it is the DEPURATED taxable base, not the gross: for a resident it is the ET art. 388 base after non-constitutive income, art. 387 deductions and the 25% exempt income; for a NON-RESIDENT taxed under art. 408 the base is the GROSS, because art. 408 admits no depuration. Note also that it sweeps in fees paid to natural persons under the art. 383 table, which are not employment income - payroll supplies only the employment component.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Rentas de trabajo - retenciones a titulo de renta
fields.Field Explanation: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. The month's total withholding at source on work income paid to natural persons. Must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Rentas de pensiones - base sujeta a retencion
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the EMPLOYER itself pays a pension. Bidirectional pair with 'Withholding - pension income' (casilla 94): a base without a withholding, or the reverse, is an inconsistency. Blank for an ordinary corporate payroll, where pensions are paid by a fund.
fields.Field Explanation: The monthly pension payment EXCEEDING 1,000 UVT (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5, for retirement, invalidity, old-age, survivor and occupational-risk pensions and for substitute indemnities and returns of pension savings. Only the excess over 1,000 UVT is taxable, so the casilla is nil for the overwhelming majority of pensions.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer pays a pension. Bidirectional pair with 'Base - pension income' (casilla 78).
fields.Field Explanation: Withholding on the taxable excess of employer-paid pension income. Summed into casilla 130.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): =non-resident payments abroad - sheet 1 summary casillas(v2.8 control B1) ===========
Base - payments abroad, no treaty (legal persons)
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises sin convenio - base
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-derived by the DIAN service from the sheet 2 annex: it is the sum of the casilla 145 values where casilla 141 = SIN AGREEMENT and casilla 143 = Legal entity. Bidirectional pair with 'Withholding - payments abroad, no treaty (legal persons)' (casilla 57) and with sheet 2 total casilla 148.
fields.Field Explanation: Base of payments to foreign ENTITIES without a Colombian domicile, in countries with no double-tax treaty. Not a payroll casilla - a foreign entity is not an employee - but shown here because it shares the sheet 2 annex with the non-resident EMPLOYEE casillas.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): Withholding - payments abroad, no treaty (legal persons)
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises sin convenio - retenciones
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-derived from sheet 2 total casilla 150. Bidirectional pair with casilla 55.
fields.Field Explanation: Withholding on payments to foreign entities in non-treaty countries. Summed into casilla 130.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises con convenio vigente - base
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-derived from sheet 2 total casilla 152. Bidirectional pair with casilla 58.
fields.Field Explanation: Base of payments to foreign entities in countries with a double-tax treaty in force.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises con convenio vigente - retenciones
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-derived from sheet 2 total casilla 154. Bidirectional pair with casilla 56.
fields.Field Explanation: Withholding on payments to foreign entities in treaty countries.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): Base - payments abroad, no treaty (NATURAL persons)
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises sin convenio - base - personas naturales
fields.Conditional Reason: THE NON-RESIDENT EMPLOYEE BASE CASILLA where the employee's country has no treaty. Auto-derived by the DIAN service from sheet 2 total casilla 149 - the sum of casilla 145 where casilla 141 = SIN AGREEMENT and casilla 143 = Natural person. Bidirectional pair with 'Withholding - payments abroad, no treaty (natural persons)' (casilla 111).
fields.Field Explanation: Gross payments to non-resident natural persons in non-treaty countries. For an employee this is the GROSS salary - ET art. 408 admits no depuration - reported through sheet 2 concept de payment 5, 'Services y compensacion por personal services'.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): Withholding - payments abroad, no treaty (NATURAL persons)
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises sin convenio - retenciones - personas naturales
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-derived from sheet 2 total casilla 151. Bidirectional pair with casilla 109.
fields.Field Explanation: Withholding on those payments - the flat 20% of ET art. 408 for employment income. Summed into casilla 130.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises con convenio vigente - base - personas naturales
fields.Conditional Reason: THE NON-RESIDENT EMPLOYEE BASE CASILLA where a double-tax treaty applies. Auto-derived from sheet 2 total casilla 153. Bidirectional pair with 'Withholding - payments abroad, treaty (natural persons)' (casilla 112).
fields.Field Explanation: Gross payments to non-resident natural persons in treaty countries, reported through sheet 2 concept de payment 24, 'Employment income' - the concept whose own definition is 'employment income de cualquier naturaleza en relacion con un empleo a favor de personas non-resident natural persons'. This is the exact place a non-resident EMPLOYEE with treaty cover is reported.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises con convenio vigente - retenciones - personas naturales
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-derived from sheet 2 total casilla 155. Bidirectional pair with casilla 110.
fields.Field Explanation: Withholding after treaty relief. Where the treaty assigns taxing rights to the residence state the rate may be reduced to nil. Mercans applies treaty relief ONLY on written client instruction supported by a residence certificate.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): A paises con o sin convenio
fields.Conditional Reason: One row per payment concept, country and person type. Drives which concept list applies in casilla 142 and which of the four totals (148, 149, 152, 153) the row feeds. Bidirectional with casilla 142 and casilla 143.
fields.Field Explanation: Drop-down: SIN AGREEMENT or CON AGREEMENT. Choosing CON AGREEMENT switches casilla 142 to the treaty concept list (19 to 33) and requires the applicable double-tax treaty to be consulted for the rate.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: The list offered depends on 'Treaty status' (casilla 141): concepts 1-18 for SIN AGREEMENT, 19-33 for CON AGREEMENT. Bidirectional pair with casilla 141.
fields.Field Explanation: For a NON-RESIDENT EMPLOYEE the two relevant concepts are: SIN AGREEMENT concept 5, 'Services y compensacion por personal services'; CON AGREEMENT concept 24, 'Employment income' - expressly 'employment income de cualquier naturaleza en relacion con un empleo'. Concept 25 covers directors' fees and concept 27 pensions. NOTE the documentation conflict recorded in the RA query column.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
fields.Query to RA: SOURCE CONFLICT, escalate. DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.2.2.26 para. 3 refers to 'la Casilla 91 - Concept de payment de la sheet dos' and to options '01. Enajenacion de activos fijos y otras withholdings' and '14. Other income'. On the currently prescribed form the sheet-2 concept de payment is CASILLA 142, and its option 14 is 'Services de transporte internacional' - option 1 is 'Intereses'. The compilation resolution appears to cite a superseded form. Confirm the correct casilla and option codes for reporting significant economic presence (ET art. 20-3) with the RA.

fields.Conditional Reason: Determines whether the row feeds the legal-person totals (148 / 150 / 152 / 154) or the natural-person totals (149 / 151 / 153 / 155). Bidirectional with casillas 141 and 142. This column is NEW in the 2024 form.
fields.Field Explanation: Legal entity or Natural person. A non-resident EMPLOYEE is always Natural person; this is the field that separates employee withholding from supplier withholding in the annex.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Required on every annex row. Where 'Treaty status' (casilla 141) = CON AGREEMENT the country must be one with a treaty in force.
fields.Field Explanation: Country receiving the payment, with its country code. Colombia's treaty network in force includes Spain, Chile, Switzerland, Canada, Mexico, South Korea, Portugal, India, the Czech Republic, the United Kingdom, France, Italy and Japan, plus Andean Community Decision 578.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Required on every annex row. Together with 'Rate' (casilla 146) it produces 'Withholding value' (casilla 147) automatically.
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.NonResident_Gross [Calculated: sum of all wage types paid to this non-resident employee in the period -- no single WTC code, an aggregate]
fields.Field Explanation: GROSS amount paid or credited to the non-resident. For an employee this is the whole salary - ET art. 408 taxes the gross, with no deduction of the mandatory social-security contributions.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Conditional Reason: Required on every annex row. Determined by ET art. 408 for non-treaty payments, or by the applicable treaty article for treaty payments. Bidirectional pair with casilla 141: the treaty status determines which rate source applies.
fields.Field Explanation: 20% is the general ET art. 408 rate for employment income and personal services. Special rates in the instruction guide include 15% for long-term foreign credits, 5% for international transport and for APP-financing interest, 33% for head-office management charges, 1% for aircraft leasing and reinsurance premiums, and 7% for foreign professors on contracts of up to four months.
fields.Rounding: Rate as a percentage.

fields.Conditional Reason: Computed automatically by the DIAN service as casilla 145 x casilla 146. Not keyed. Bidirectional with casillas 145 and 146.
fields.Field Explanation: The instruction guide states expressly that 'el SI de Diligenciamiento calcula automaticamente los values de las withholdings multiplicando el value registrado en la casilla 145 por la rate registrada en la casilla 146'. Payroll supplies 145 and 146; it must NOT attempt to key 147.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): Total base - no treaty, legal persons
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos al exterior paises sin convenio persona juridica
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-summed where casilla 141 = SIN AGREEMENT and casilla 143 = Legal entity. Feeds sheet 1 casilla 55.
fields.Field Explanation: Sum of casilla 145 across the matching annex rows. Carried up to sheet 1 casilla 55.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): Total base - no treaty, natural persons
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos al exterior paises sin convenio persona natural
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-summed where casilla 141 = SIN AGREEMENT and casilla 143 = Natural person. Feeds sheet 1 casilla 109.
fields.Field Explanation: Sum of casilla 145 across the matching annex rows. This is where a non-resident employee in a non-treaty country lands. Carried up to sheet 1 casilla 109.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): Total withholding - no treaty, legal persons
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor retencion sin convenio persona juridica
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-summed; feeds sheet 1 casilla 57.
fields.Field Explanation: Sum of casilla 147 across the matching annex rows.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): Total withholding - no treaty, natural persons
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor retencion sin convenio persona natural
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-summed; feeds sheet 1 casilla 111.
fields.Field Explanation: Sum of casilla 147 across the matching annex rows - the non-resident employee withholding in non-treaty countries.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos al exterior paises con convenio persona juridica
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-summed; feeds sheet 1 casilla 56.
fields.Field Explanation: Sum of casilla 145 across the matching annex rows.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos al exterior paises con convenio persona natural
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-summed; feeds sheet 1 casilla 110.
fields.Field Explanation: Sum of casilla 145 across the matching annex rows - where a non-resident employee covered by a treaty lands, under concept de payment 24.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor retencion con convenio persona juridica
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-summed; feeds sheet 1 casilla 58.
fields.Field Explanation: Sum of casilla 147 across the matching annex rows.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Retenciones sobre pagos al exterior paises con convenio persona natural
fields.Conditional Reason: Auto-summed; feeds sheet 1 casilla 112.
fields.Field Explanation: Sum of casilla 147 across the matching annex rows - the non-resident employee withholding after treaty relief.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): =non-payroll withholding concepts - not produced by payroll ===========
Bases and withholdings on legal persons
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Bases y retenciones a personas juridicas
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated by the client's accounts-payable function where the corresponding payment was made. Payroll contributes nothing.
fields.Field Explanation: Fourteen concept pairs for payments to legal persons - fees (29 / 42), commissions (30 / 43), services (31 / 44), rendimientos financieros (32 / 45), arrendamientos (33 / 46), regalias (34 / 47), dividendos (35 / 48), compras (36 / 49), tarjetas (37 / 50), contracts de construccion (38 / 51), loterias (39 / 52), hidrocarburos (40 / 53) and other payments (41 / 54). Not produced by payroll. Present on the form because Form 350 aggregates EVERY withholding the employer makes, not only payroll withholding. Populated by the client's accounts-payable or tax function; payroll contributes nothing to this casilla.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (EN): Bases and withholdings on natural persons, non-employment concepts
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Bases y retenciones a personas naturales - conceptos no laborales
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated by accounts payable. Payroll contributes only casillas 77 / 93 and, where applicable, 78 / 94.
fields.Field Explanation: The same concept grid repeated for natural persons - fees (79 / 95), commissions (80 / 96), services (81 / 97), and so on to other payments (92 / 108), plus enajenacion de activos fijos (89 / 105) which exists only in the natural-person column. Fees paid to a natural person under the art. 383 table can straddle 77 / 93 and 79 / 95; the boundary is a client decision, documented in the Population Rules. Not produced by payroll. Present on the form because Form 350 aggregates EVERY withholding the employer makes, not only payroll withholding. Populated by the client's accounts-payable or tax function; payroll contributes nothing to this casilla.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where the employer is an authorised self-withholding agent. Casilla 59 / 68 is the art. 114-1 self-withholding driven by casillas 27 and 28.
fields.Field Explanation: Self-withholding on the employer's OWN income - ventas, fees, commissions, services, rendimientos financieros, mining exports and other concepts, for legal persons (59-76) and natural persons (113-128). Not produced by payroll. Present on the form because Form 350 aggregates EVERY withholding the employer makes, not only payroll withholding. Populated by the client's accounts-payable or tax function; payroll contributes nothing to this casilla.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated by the client's tax function. Casilla 132 is the withholding on services supplied by non-residents or non-domiciled persons.
fields.Field Explanation: 131 VAT withheld from VAT-responsible suppliers; 132 VAT withheld on services from non-residents; 133 excess or undue VAT withholding reversed; 134 total VAT withholding (131 + 132 - 133); 135 national stamp-duty withholding. Not produced by payroll. Present on the form because Form 350 aggregates EVERY withholding the employer makes, not only payroll withholding. Populated by the client's accounts-payable or tax function; payroll contributes nothing to this casilla.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Menos retenciones practicadas en exceso o indebidas
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where withholding was practised in excess or in error, or on transactions annulled, rescinded or resolved. Subtracted in casilla 130.
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Withholding_Reversal [No dedicated WTC code found -- a correction/reversal mechanism applied at the engine level, not a standing wage type]
fields.Field Explanation: Amounts over-withheld or wrongly withheld, and reversals of withholding on cancelled transactions. Where the month's withholding is insufficient to absorb the credit, the instruction guide permits carrying it to the immediately following periods. Payroll DOES feed this casilla where an employee's withholding is corrected downward in a later month.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.
Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Explanation: Casilla 130 (income tax) plus casilla 134 (VAT) plus casilla 135 (stamp duty).
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where a penalty arises on this filing - late filing or correction. Feeds casilla 138.
fields.Field Explanation: Total penalties arising from this return. The instruction guide warns that the penalty declared cannot be less than the minimum penalty of 10 UVT (COP 523,740 in 2026) for late filing, and that for a corrective return the minimum is 10 UVT of the year in which the ORIGINAL return was filed.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Explanation: Casilla 136 plus casilla 137. This is the amount that must be PAID IN FULL: a withholding return filed without full payment produces NO legal effect, with no administrative act needed to say so (ET art. 580-1, quoted in the instruction guide).
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Explanation: NIT assigned by DIAN to the person signing the return - the legal representative or an authorised agent.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Explanation: Verification digit of the signatory's NIT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Explanation: The amount actually paid with the return. Reserved-range casilla. Must equal casilla 138 for the return to have legal effect.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

fields.Field Explanation: Type of representation of the person signing for the declarant, taken from casilla 98 of the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where the return must be signed by an accountant or a statutory auditor. Bidirectional set with 'Professional card number' (casilla 983) and 'With qualifications' (casilla 994): where 982 is populated, 983 is mandatory and 994 becomes available.
fields.Field Explanation: 1 = Contador, 2 = Revisor fiscal. The instruction guide sets the thresholds: an accountant must sign where the taxpayer keeps books and gross assets at the preceding year end exceeded 100,000 UVT; a statutory auditor must sign for joint-stock companies, for companies whose gross assets reach 5,000 SMMLV, and for companies whose gross income reaches 3,000 SMMLV.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Mandatory where 'Accountant or statutory auditor code' (casilla 982) is populated; blank otherwise. Bidirectional pair with casilla 982.
fields.Format: AN - prefix pattern ^[0-9]{1,6}-T$: the numeric registration followed by a hyphen and the literal suffix T (for Contador). Store the printed value including the -T suffix; do not strip it, because the Junta quotes the card with it
fields.Field Explanation: Professional card number issued by the Junta Central de Contadores. The -T suffix is part of the identifier, not a separator.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Available only where 'Accountant or statutory auditor code' (casilla 982) is populated. Bidirectional pair with casilla 982.
fields.Field Explanation: Marked with an x where the accountant or statutory auditor signs with qualifications.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Espacio exclusivo para el sello de la entidad recaudadora
fields.Field Explanation: DISPLAY-ONLY. Reserved for the collecting bank's stamp on a paper receipt. It is not a data field, is not keyed and is not transmitted; it exists on the printed representation only.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
